exact_theorem.common_prefix_minimality: exact least-squares residuals certify all earlier prefixes infeasible and the selected prefix feasible
exact_theorem.outward_interval_rule: every rational operation is enclosed on the 10^-36 grid by floor/ceiling endpoint rounding
exact_theorem.primal_upper_bound: any exact feasible c gives B_tau(b)<=c^T M c

protocol.common_prefix_rule: least profile prefix feasible for the weighted minimum target; the positive control is evaluated on that same prefix
protocol.rho_seed_rule: fixed rational seed table followed by exact 999/1000 shrink until residual feasibility
protocol.target_rule: TPC-312 exact Gram minimum label and all-positive control
